fields.name: DAILY_WEATHER_MEAS_GUID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the record.

fields.name: WEATHER_STATION_GUID
fields.description: A foreign key to WEATHER_STATION

fields.name: WEATHER_TIMESTAMP_MSEC
fields.description: The date and time a weather measurement is collected as measured by milliseconds since epoch

fields.name: WEATHER_TIMESTAMP
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of when the weather measurement was taken

fields.name: DAILY_MEASUREMENT_TYPE_CODE
fields.description: A foreign key to DAILY_MEASUREMENT_TYPE_CODE

fields.name: TEMPERATURE
fields.description: The temperature measured in degrees Celsius by the weather station

fields.name: TEMPERATURE_MIN
fields.description: The daily low (minimum) temperature for the day measured in degrees Celsius

fields.name: TEMPERATURE_MAX
fields.description: The daily high (maximum) temperature for the day measured in degrees Celsius

fields.name: RELATIVE_HUMIDITY
fields.description: A measure of the relative humidity by the weather station

fields.name: RELATIVE_HUMIDITY_MIN
fields.description: The daily low (minimum) Humidity measurement for the day

fields.name: RELATIVE_HUMIDITY_MAX
fields.description: The daily high (maximum) Humidity measurement for the day

fields.name: PRECIPITATION
fields.description: A measure of precipitation by the weather station

fields.name: WIND_SPEED
fields.description: A measure of wind speed in kilometres/hour by the weather station

fields.name: WIND_DIRECTION_DEGREES
fields.description: The direction the wind measured in degrees as measured by the weather station. Values fall within the range 0.0 - 359.0

fields.name: ADJUSTED_WIND_SPEED
fields.description: An adjusted measure of wind speed in kilometres/hour by the weather station

fields.name: DAILY_SEVERITY_RATING
fields.description: A numeric rating describing the difficulty of controlling fires

fields.name: DROUGHT_CODE
fields.description: A numerical rating of the moisture content of deep, compact, organic layers

fields.name: DUFF_MOISTURE_CODE
fields.description: A numerical rating of the average moisture content of loosely compacted organic layers of moderate depth

fields.name: FINE_FUEL_MOISTURE_CODE
fields.description: A measure of the moisture content (dryness) of the smallest forest fuels (surface litter, leaves, needles, small twigs, etc)

fields.name: GRASSLAND_CURING
fields.description: A numeric rating of the state of the grassland moisture levels

fields.name: BUILD_UP_INDEX
fields.description: The amount of fuel available for combustion, indicating how the fire will develop after initial spread

fields.name: DANGER_FOREST_INDEX
fields.description: An index calculation specific to BC that is based on location Build Up Index and Fire Weather Index. Values fall in the range of 1-5

fields.name: DANGER_GRASSLAND_INDEX
fields.description: An index calculation specific to BC that is based on location Initial Spread Index and Grass Curing. Values fall in the range of 1-5

fields.name: DANGER_SCRUB_INDEX
fields.description: An index calculation specific to BC that is based on location Initial Spread Index and Fine Fuel Moisture Code. Values fall in the range of 1-5

fields.name: FIRE_WEATHER_INDEX
fields.description: Fire Weather Index is calculated from the Initial Spread Index and a measure called BUI (Build-Up Index), and provides a numerical rating of the likely intensity of a fire. Values are: 0-4.5 : Low 4.5-10.5: Moderate 10.5-18.5: High 18.5-29.5: Very High 29.5+: Extreme

fields.name: INITIAL_SPREAD_INDEX
fields.description: Initial Spread Index indicates the rate fire will spread in its early stages. It is calculated from the FFMC rating and the wind factor. A high rating indicates a high rate of spread. Measured values translate as: 0-1.5 : Low 2-4: Moderate 5-8: High 9-15: Very High 16+: Extreme

fields.name: MISSING_HOURLY_DATA_IND
fields.description: Missing Hourly Data Ind indicates whether the measurements collected by this record are missing hourly data (Y) or not (N)

fields.name: OBSERVATION_VALID_IND
fields.description: Observation Valid Ind indicates whether one or more weather observations is within an acceptable range of values (Y) or is outside of a valid range (N)

fields.name: OBSERVATION_VALID_COMMENT
fields.description: Comments provided that describe issues with one or more sensors that are affecting observations

fields.name: ARCHIVED_IND
fields.description: Archived Ind indicates whether the measurement is archived (Y) or not (N)

fields.name: LAST_UPDATED_TIMESTAMP_MSEC
fields.description: The last date and time the record was updated as measured by milliseconds since epoch

fields.name: LAST_UPDATED_TIMESTAMP
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of when the record was last updated

fields.name: CREATE_USER
fields.description: An audit column that indicates the user that created the record

fields.name: CREATE_DATE
fields.description: The date and time the row of data was created

fields.name: UPDATE_USER
fields.description: An audit column that indicates the user that updated the record.

fields.name: UPDATE_DATE
fields.description: The date and time the row of data was updated.
